name: Ryuzaki Saya
source:
She's an anchor of a news program for which the main character is the director. She is mainly in charge of political and economic news. As a veteran newscaster, she makes no mistakes and is quick-witted.

Although she is a natural at her job, she has a generous personality and is like a big sister to the other newscasters.

She is married with a one-year-old child. Her husband is her only sexual experience, and she is a chaste married woman.

[From [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item1768?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
